title: Does this look like a game you would play?
author: mjkoskinen
selftext:
Honest feedback needed! This is my first go at game development and could use your input. I've had the idea for this game for years I'm finally making it a reality! It is a cozy pixel-art space themed RPG. The concept is that humans are evacuating earth to live on mars and search out other plants. The player will make difficult decisions and face the consequences. Get lost in side missions or focus on the main ones depending on your preference. Combat is turn based with dodge/attack timers.

Developed using opus 5.5, no game engine, all art is procedural and it runs in the browser. A free playable demo will be coming soon.

comments.author: Fuzzzy420
comments.body:
Nop. Artstyle is all over the place. You should stick to one. Ui is very minimal and has no soul. 
The assets have very different level of detail. Sometimes you have pixel art but then the floor in the city looks terrible, not only that it's just a mask and you can tell but then it's higher Res then the rest. 

The combat is more like a Pokémon type system?

Try to polish the city until it looks awesome and then continue to do that for every part of your game (:

replies.author: mjkoskinen
replies.body: Solid points, thanks! Yes combat is a little like pokemon but with multiple party members and the timings

replies.author: Fuzzzy420
replies.body:
You clearly put a lot of effort in, but it doesn't show through your art, just through the number of scenes that you show. 

Polish just one scene and post again here before going all in on a total rework. 
Good luck

comments.author: Saytron3030
comments.body: This is a classic case of just because you can doesn't mean you should

comments.author: GKR990
comments.body:
I like the concept, and you have clearly put some work into it, but it is a pretty ambitious concept and you haven't put quite enough effort in for me to want to spend my time with it, when there are so many excellent hand-crafted games out there that I don't have time for. 

I'd either need a really good hook, or to not see ANY signs of less-than-top-tier effort (the menus in the video, for example).

comments.author: Extempes
comments.body: Idk for me personaly  the Art Style has Something, but I probably wouldnt play it cuz Combat doesnt Look Like Something ID enjoy. But I can definitely See the Work you Put into that Game !
